sections.heading: Start here, in this order
sections.intro: Stable conditions solve more problems than product collecting.

steps.title: Give the fish enough water
steps.text: Choose an aquarium that can hold stable temperature and water chemistry.

steps.title: Heat, filter and cycle it
steps.text: A tropical fish needs warmth, gentle filtration and established biological processing.

steps.title: Learn the water numbers
steps.text: Ammonia and nitrite are urgent; stability matters more than chasing a perfect pH.

steps.title: Feed deliberately
steps.text: Use suitable protein-rich foods and small, observable portions.

steps.title: Observe before treating
steps.text: Behaviour, appetite, breathing and water tests provide context; medication is not the first answer to every symptom.

sections.heading: What trust means here
sections.text: We separate routine husbandry from health guidance, show the limits of online information and block high-risk pages until their sources and reviewer are verified.
